JSWHL.NS.d: JSW Holdings Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in investing and financing activities. The company was formerly known as Jindal South West Holdings Limited and changed its name to JSW Holdings Limited in 2013. JSW Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Mumbai, India.

KAMOPAINTS.NS.d: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited is an Indian company with two divisions: steel trading, which distributes TMT bars and structural steel, and paints, which makes emulsions for exteriors and interiors, water-based primers, wood finishes, textured and designer paints and construction chemicals. Gurgaon is its base, and it dates from 2008.

LTFOODS.NS.d: LT Foods Limited, set up in 1980, with its head office in Gurugram, covers the rice value chain from milling and processing to worldwide marketing of basmati rice, branded and unbranded, plus other foods made from rice. Its range includes basmati, brown, steamed, parboiled, organic, quick-cooking and specialty rice such as Arborio.

MAANALU.NS.d: Maan Aluminium Limited manufactures and trades in aluminum profiles, ingots, billets, and other related products in India. The company offers geometrical shapes; architectural structures, such as doors and windows, curtain walls, structural glazing products, and others; AC grills and equipment; architectural hardware; industrial products; and solar panels. It also trades in ingots and billets, and non-ferrous scrap.

MINDACORP.NS.d: Minda Corporation Limited manufactures and sells automobile components and parts. It offers electronic and mechanical security systems, including ignition switch cum steering locks, smart key systems, mechatronic handles, and immobilizers systems; die casting components, such as aluminum high pressure die casting and compressor housing products; and starter motors and alternators.

MIRCELECTR.NS.d: MIRC Electronics Limited manufactures and markets electronics and consumer durables in India. It offers LED and LCD televisions, air conditioners, washing machines, microwave ovens, DVD home theatre systems, mobile phones, projector systems, infrared thermometers, refrigerators, and LED lights under the Onida and IGO brands. The company also exports its products. MIRC Electronics Limited was founded in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.

MIRZAINT.NS.d: Mirza International Limited manufactures and markets leather footwear and finished leather products in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Tannery Division, Shoe Division, and Garments/Accessories Division. The company offers men's and women's footwear; and formal, semi-formal, and casual footwear.

MODIRUBBER.NS.d: Modi Rubber Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides automobile tires, tubes, and flaps in India. The company also manufacture and sell resin coated sand; and operates salons. Modi Rubber Limited was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

MPSLTD.NS.d: MPS Limited provides platforms and services for content creation, full-service production, and distribution to the publishers, learning companies, corporate institutions, libraries, and content aggregators in India, Europe, the United States, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Content Solutions, Platform Solutions, and eLearning Solutions.

NAGAFERT.NS.d: Nagarjuna Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited manufactures and markets fertilizers and micro irrigation equipment in India and internationally. It manufactures urea and anhydrous ammonia; and markets diammonium phosphate, muriate of potash, zinc sulphate heptahydrate, zinc sulphate mono-hydrate, chelated zinc, di-sodium octa borate tetra hydrate, and specialty fertilizers.

ORIENTLTD.NS.d: Orient Press Limited provides printing and packaging solutions. It operates through three segments: Printing, Flexible Packaging, and Paper Board Packaging.

PATANJALI.NS.d: Patanjali Foods Limited, established in Indore in 1986, mainly processes oilseeds and refines crude oil for edible use in India. It reports in seed extraction, vanaspati, oils, food and wind power segments. Its products include edible oils, vanaspati, bakery fats, textured soya protein, flour, honey and coffee, as well as seeds, soaps and toiletries.

PICCADIL.NS.d: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited, established in 1953 and based in Gurugram, makes alcoholic beverages through Sugar and Distillery divisions. Its drinks include malt whisky, aged rum, sugarcane juice rum, vodka and country liquors, alongside ethanol. It also makes white crystal sugar, rectified spirit, carbon dioxide and extra neutral alcohol.

PILITA.NS.d: Pil Italica Lifestyle Limited manufactures and sells plastic molded furniture and other articles in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Manufacturing, Trading, and Finance. The company offers plastic chairs, tables, patla/stools, trolleys, sun loungers, storage and waste bins, and crates under the ITALICA brand. Its products are used in homes, offices, stadiums, gardens, playgrounds, beaches, and others.

RAJMET.NS.d: Rajnandini Metal Limited engages in the trading of various metals in India and internationally. Its products include base/primary metals, secondary metals and alloys, minor metals, ferro-alloys, ferrous and non-ferrous scraps, recyclable plastic scraps, finished and semi-finished metals and steel products, and alloying additives for smelters and foundries.

RAMRAT.NS.d: Ram Ratna Wires Limited and its subsidiaries make and sell winding wires in India and abroad, with segments for enamelled wires and strips, for copper tubes and pipes, and for other products. Offerings include enameled aluminium and copper wires, submersible and corona resistant wires, Litz wires, paper-covered conductors and bare copper wires.

RBMINFRA.NS.d: RBM Infracon Ltd. is an Indian infrastructure company that provides comprehensive Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services, along with integrated operations, maintenance, and turnaround services. The company specializes in mechanical and rotary equipment, offering solutions such as structural, tankage, and piping fabrication and erection, detailed engineering and design, and maintenance for mechanical and civil works.

RELIABLE-SM.NS.d: RELIABLE DATA SERV likely provides data-related services, possibly including data processing, storage, or analytics, and is located in India; detailed understanding of the range of services would further clarify its business model.

ROML.NS.d: Raj Oil Mills Limited is an Indian company that manufactures and markets edible oils and fats. Their product portfolio includes various types of cooking oils. The company's headquarters are located in Mumbai, India.

S&SPOWER.NS.d: S&S Power Switchgear Limited designs, manufactures, and sells circuit breaker products for indoor and outdoor applications in India and internationally. It offers spare parts and services; retrofit solutions, including circuit breaker and disconnector retrofit solutions; circuit breakers; medium voltage switchgear panels; and offload disconnectors, such as horizontal center and double breaks, pantographs, and vertical breaks.

SARVESHWAR.NS.d: Sarveshwar Foods Limited, established in 1890 and headquartered in Jammu, produces and distributes rice in India, in both basmati and non-basmati varieties such as brown, steam, parboiled and long grain white rice. It also sells organic food products under its Nimbark brand.

SEDEMAC.NS.d: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited develops and manufactures control technologies, such as controllers for generators and vehicles. Its products include supervisory and engine controllers for generators and motor controllers for vehicles, as well as electronic fuel injection and integrated starter generator controls for combustion-engine two-wheelers, produced in volume at its own facilities.

SILINV.NS.d: SIL Investments Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the commercial finance and investments activities in India. The company invests in shares, securities, and real estate. The company was formerly known as Sutlej Industries Limited and changed its name to SIL Investments Limited in March 2007. SIL Investments Limited was incorporated in 1934 and is based in Bhawanimandi, India.

SMARTWORKS.NS.d: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Ltd., headquartered in Gurugram and founded in 2015, owns, manages and leases flexible coworking spaces in India. Its services include serviced and furnished offices, virtual office solutions, facilities for meetings and training, and related support services.

STARCEMENT.NS.d: Star Cement Limited manufactures and sells cement and clinker products in north eastern and eastern states of India. It operates through Cement and Power segments. The company offers ordinary Portland, Portland pozzolana, Portland slag, and antirust cement products under the Star Cement brand. It also generates power. The company markets its products through a network of dealers and retailers. It also exports its products to Nepal and Bhutan.

SUMMITSEC.NS.d: Summit Securities Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in investment and financial activities. The investments of the firm are typically long term in nature and predominantly in the equity markets. The firm typically invests in companies in real estate sector. Summit Securities Limited was formerly known as RPG Itochu Finance Limited. The company was incorporated on January 30, 1997 and is based in Mumbai, India.

TDPOWERSYS.NS.d: TD Power Systems Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells AC generators and electric motors in India and internationally. It operates through Manufacturing Business and Project Business segments.

TRACXN.NS.d: Tracxn Technologies Limited runs a private market intelligence platform used worldwide. The platform supplies company profiles, funding and M&A deals, financials, valuations, competitive landscapes and industry reports. Its users include venture capital and private equity funds, investment banks, corporate development teams, startup founders, journalists and universities.

USASEEDS.NS.d: Upsurge Seeds of Agriculture Ltd. is an Indian agricultural company primarily engaged in the processing, marketing, growing, and development of various seeds. The company focuses on providing high-quality seeds to farmers to enhance crop yields and agricultural productivity. Its product portfolio includes a range of field crops such as cumin, coriander, groundnut, wheat, and bajra, as well as various vegetable seeds, which are marketed under the 'Upsurge' or 'USA SEEDS' brand.

VILINBIO.NS.d: Vilin Bio Med Ltd. is a domestic pharmaceutical company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and trading of pharmaceutical products, with a focus on generic formulations across various therapeutic segments. The company produces pharmaceutical formulations such as oral liquids, dry syrups, sachets, external preparations, beta and non-beta lactam tablets and capsules, and nutritional food supplements.

VISHWAS.NS.d: Vishwas Agri Seeds Ltd. is an Indian agricultural company primarily engaged in the processing and distribution of a diverse range of seeds. The company's core business involves providing vegetable seeds, hybrid seeds, and self-pollinated seeds, including varieties such as groundnut, cumin, wheat, mustard, chili, tomato, brinjal, okra, watermelon, pearl millet, maize, and cotton. Vishwas Agri Seeds Ltd.

VIVIDHA.NS.d: Visagar Polytex Limited engages in the design, manufacture, wholesale, retail, and trade of textiles in India. It offers ethnic wear, including sarees, lehangas, and suits; interlining goods; and various fabrics. The company also operates a retail chain that offer designer sarees under the Vividha brand. In addition, it is involved in the contract-based manufacturing activity. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

VNL.NS.d: Vishal Nirmiti Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker VNL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

VSTL.NS.d: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited, established in 2003 and headquartered in Hisar, India, makes and distributes steel pipes and tubes in India. Its range includes crash barriers, cold-rolled strips and coils, hollow pipes, mild steel and carbon ERW pipes (black and galvanised), and pre-painted tubes.

ZEEL.NS.d: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in broadcasting satellite television channels.
